servers.name: Gmail
servers.notes: owning_agents = WRITERS (Pillar 1). Filer = sole labeler (gmail.modify only, never delete). Herald = drafts via gmail.readonly + gmail.compose (draft only, no send — drafting IS a write). No delete/archive tool registered — unreachable by construction (Pillar 2).

servers.name: Google Calendar
servers.notes: owning_agents = WRITERS (Pillar 1): Sundial/Usher = calendar.events (write, no delete). Compass = calendar.readonly — a READER, never route a calendar write to it. No delete tool registered (Pillar 2).

servers.name: Google Drive
servers.notes: owning_agents = WRITERS (Pillar 1): Steward exports use drive.file (app-scoped). Codex reads use drive.readonly. Archivist, Quill, Envoy = drive.readonly READERS — never route a Drive write to them. Never whole-Drive scope.

servers.name: Google Sheets
servers.notes: Optional — only when a tracker lives in Sheets. Headhunter job funnel; Steward for counter projections.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.notes: GitHub App (not PAT). Write/PR-open gated behind Pillar 2 confirmation. Token minted server-side per run (mintTokenForUse) — never returned to MCP client. Envoy owns portfolio/project writes.

servers.name: Obsidian
servers.notes: STEWARD ONLY (Pillar 1 — sole Vault writer). All Vault writes funnel via atlas-wire -> Steward -> local bridge. No other agent may call Obsidian write tools. Bridge authenticates outbound; no inbound port on laptop (ATLAS_BRIDGE_TOKEN gated).

servers.name: Playwright / browser
servers.notes: Use ONLY for sites with no first-party MCP. Outward actions (form submit, post) are ALWAYS gated by Pillar 2 confirmation gate before execution. Captcha and payment are hard stops. Usher=registrations; Envoy=prefill-only (no auto-post).

servers.name: Canva
servers.notes: Optional. Not yet connected. Envoy owns Canva publishing (Pillar-2 gated). Librarian only STORES prompts with tool:"Canva" — a metadata relationship, NOT ownership; never route a Canva design write to Librarian.

servers.name: Notion
servers.notes: Optional — only if owner uses Notion for structured external docs. Not connected.

servers.name: Slack
servers.notes: Optional — only if owner uses Slack for team/channel communication. Not connected.

servers.name: context7
servers.notes: Design-time only. Used by Switchboard itself and dev work to fetch current library/SDK/API docs. Not a domain MCP — no external writes, no OAuth.

servers.name: cloudflare-docs
servers.notes: Design-time only. Official Cloudflare docs (Workers, DOs, Queues, Workflows, D1/KV/R2, AI Gateway, Wrangler). No auth required.

specificity_over_generality.description: First-party MCP server (e.g. Google Calendar) beats driving the same site through a browser when both can do the job. Reserve Playwright for sites with no MCP.

read_before_write.description: If the goal can be met read-only, never shortlist write tools. Only escalate to write tools when the intent explicitly requires mutation.

health_penalty.description: A disconnected (health=absent) or degraded (health=degraded) server is penalized heavily. degraded: -0.4, absent: excluded entirely from shortlist.

pillar1_single_writer.description: HARD RULE (Pillar 1): Never recommend a second writer for a resource an existing agent owns. Route all Vault writes through Steward. Route all outward publishing through Envoy. Route all calendar writes through Sundial/Usher.

pillar2_gate_irreversible.description: HARD RULE (Pillar 2): Any intent whose verb is in side_effect_verbs MUST carry confirmation_gate=true and name the executing agent. An ungated outward toolset is a P1 gap, never a silent recommendation.

no_mcp_for_capability.description: No connected MCP server covers a required capability.

mcp_disconnected_blocks_goal.description: A required MCP is disconnected or unhealthy and the gap blocks the current in-flight goal.

missing_oauth_scope.description: A required OAuth scope is not yet granted to the executing agent. Requires owner consent — do not proceed.

ungated_outward_toolset.description: A recommended toolset includes an outward/irreversible action (side_effect_verb) but the confirmation gate flag is absent. This is a critical defect — never emit an ungated outward recommendation.
